doc.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017

title: Thanks and goodbye
summary: Rowe thanks Fleming, they joke about ten percent, and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well on that note, I appreciate you spending this hour with me. It’s been very informative and interesting.
All right. If you start getting rich, I want ten percent.
All right. We’ve got a little contract just for that. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
Anyway it was a pleasure doing it and I hope you use it for good.
